description:
Create a workspace only when the caller has operator workspace-create scope; otherwise the request is rejected without mutation.

Call resolve_workspace first. This setup primitive does not provision use-case kits, run workflows, insert candidate rows, send messages to customers, write CRM/calendar, call SignalKit receive, trigger routines, or spend provider credits.

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

billingPlanHint.description: Optional billing policy hint, e.g. trial_or_low_fixed_cap

clientDomain.description: Firm/client domain used for idempotent matching

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key for the workspace request

initialAgentTemplate.description: Optional initial agent template hint, e.g. vc-analyst

locale.description: Locale used by workspace bootstrap; defaults to en

ownerUserId.description: Known owner user id, when already resolved

reason.description: Plain-language reason for the workspace request

sourceRequestId.description: Source thread, approval, or request id

name: create_workspace
